name: Matcha Starter Kit
summary: Everything needed to make a proper bowl: a bamboo chasen, a stoneware chawan, a chashaku scoop and 30g of Daily Matcha. The sensible way to start, and cheaper than buying the four separately.
description:
A practical introduction to traditional matcha preparation. This set includes 30 grams of Daily Matcha, a bamboo chasen whisk, bamboo chashaku scoop, and fine mesh sifter.

Together, these tools provide everything needed to prepare a smooth bowl of matcha at home. The Daily Matcha offers a balanced, approachable flavor suitable for straight preparation or lattes, while the included utensils support proper technique from the start.

A thoughtful set for those beginning a matcha practice or for anyone seeking a complete, uncomplicated preparation kit.
